headline: 'Forget about going back': 9 years on, Rohingya crisis enters dangerous phase
context: The world largely moved on from the Rohingya crisis. But the exodus has not stopped, aid is shrinking and a generation of refugees is growing up with little prospect of going home.

sources.name: NPR
